description: DiligenceOps: submit a warranty claim (the issue, purchase date and optionally the delivery date, claim date, part, cause, remedy and a stated warranty length) and the warranty terms. The signed report counts the applicable period from purchase or delivery to an end date, says whether the claim falls inside it, whether the coverage names the issue or covers defects in general, which exclusions the cause or issue meets, and whether the remedy asked for is offered, listing each period, coverage and exclusion mismatch with quotes. POST /api/warranty-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

cause.description: Optional account of how the problem came about, for example "normal use" or "dropped on tile".

claimed_at.description: When the claim is made. Defaults to the check date.

component.description: Optional part affected, for example battery or screen.

delivered_at.description: Optional delivery date, used when the terms count the period from delivery.

issue.description: The defect or problem claimed, for example "The battery no longer holds a charge".

period_claimed.description: Optional warranty length the seller or listing states, for example "2 years", checked against the terms.

purchased_at.description: Purchase date, which starts the warranty period unless the terms count from delivery.

remedy.description: Optional remedy the claim asks for.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

terms.description: The warranty terms, up to 256 KB.

terms_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

name: wever_warranty-check
title: Warranty check
